[Log-derived analysis] Verifies 2FA self-registration using the default (local) authentication: a user can register and the generated TOTP/OTP is accepted for login.

1353.9000.12.description:
2FA self-registration - default authentication, testing different users/scenarios

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies 2FA self-registration with default authentication across multiple users and edge-case scenarios, confirming each registers and authenticates correctly.

1353.9000.20.description:
2FA self-registration, RADIUS authentication

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies 2FA self-registration backed by RADIUS authentication: the user registers and the 2FA code is accepted alongside RADIUS credentials.

1353.9000.21.description:
2FA self-registration, firewall blocked RADIUS authentication server

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies 2FA self-registration behaviour when the RADIUS server is unreachable due to a firewall block, confirming the failure is handled gracefully.

1353.9000.22.description:
2FA self-registration - RADIUS authentication, testing different users/scenarios

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies 2FA self-registration with RADIUS authentication across multiple users and scenarios, confirming correct registration and authentication outcomes.

1353.9000.23.description:
Test an OpenVPN connection (RADIUS authentication) with 2FA code generated via CLI

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies an OpenVPN connection using RADIUS authentication succeeds with a 2FA code generated via the CLI.

1353.9000.24.description:
Test an OpenVPN connection (RADIUS authentication) with 2FA code generated via self-registration

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies an OpenVPN connection using RADIUS authentication succeeds with a 2FA code obtained through self-registration.

1353.9000.30.description:
2FA Email OTP default, custom, edited templates

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies 2FA email-OTP message templates (default, custom, and edited) are applied correctly when sending one-time codes by email.

1353.9000.31.description:

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies a 2FA email OTP is actually sent via SMTP and that the corresponding 2FA log entries are recorded.

1353.9000.32.description:

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies an OpenVPN connection using RADIUS authentication succeeds with a 2FA code delivered via email OTP.

1353.9001.100.description:
gcm8 IPSEC IPv4 traffic test

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies IPsec IPv4 data-plane traffic protected with the AES-GCM crypto profile. Brings up the IPsec peer between the two routers, confirms baseline connectivity, then runs unidirectional/bidirectional traffic across the encrypted path and checks the SA is established and traffic is correctly carried over the tunnel. Restores and verifies config afterwards.
